```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")
categories
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = as.Date(
      lubridate::parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("Y-m-d", "B d, Y"))
    )
  )

metadata |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id")
```

```{r}
crypto <- prices |>
  group_by(date_raw) |>
  summarise(total_market_cap_trillions = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e12) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw))

crypto |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_market_cap_trillions)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Cryptocurrency Market Cap",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Market Cap (trillions of USD)"
  )
```
